segments.sn17.7:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.7:1.3: Kaṃ, bhikkhave, diddhagatena visallena sallena [diṭṭhigatena visallena (ka. sī.), diṭṭhigatena sallena (syā. kaṃ.), diṭṭhigatena visallena sallena (ka.), diṭṭhagatena visallena sallena (pī.)] vijjhatu, sekhaṃ [vijjhatu, taṃ sekhaṃ (sī.), vijjhati, taṃ sekhaṃ (pī. ka.)] appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātu”[anupāpuṇāti (pī. ka.)].
segments.sn17.7:2.2: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban”ti.
